factCards.text: Where We Are, the group's first stadium tour, opened in Bogota in April 2014; two nights at San Siro in Milan that June were filmed and released as a concert film.
factCards.sourceTitle: Where We Are — Live from San Siro Stadium (Columbia, 2014)

factCards.text: 5 Seconds of Summer opened for the group on the Take Me Home and Where We Are tours before their own debut album appeared in 2014.
factCards.sourceTitle: Take Me Home Tour and Where We Are Tour billing, 2013-2014

factCards.text: On the Road Again began in Sydney in February 2015 and was the last tour the group played before the break.
factCards.sourceTitle: On the Road Again Tour schedule, 2015
